subject: Biology
source_note: TIE (2023), Biology Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, principles and processes of Biology

sub_topics.title: Describe the physiological, anatomical and ecological processes of living organisms
competences: (a) Describe coordination in plants (tropic, responses) and animals (nervous coordination in human, structure of neurones, sense organs and endocrine system)
(b) Describe the mechanism of excretion in the human body (systems: organs, products)
(c) Describe the mechanism of regulation in the human body (temperature regulation, blood sugar regulation and osmoregulation)

objectives.text: (a) Describe coordination in plants (tropic, responses) and animals (nervous coordination in human, structure of neurones, sense organs and endocrine system)
objectives.resources: Models/pictures of sense organs, young plants, charts showing plants tropic responses, models/charts/ pictures showing structure of neurones and online resouces on plants and animals coordination
objectives.assessment_criteria: Coordination in plants and animals described clearly

objectives.text: (b) Describe the mechanism of excretion in the human body (systems: organs, products)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Group discussion, ICT based learning
objectives.resources: Models/ charts/ pictures of human urinary system, picture of mammalian kidney, online resources on human excretion and charts illustrating disoders of human excretory system
objectives.assessment_criteria: The mechanism of excretion in human body is described clearly

objectives.text: (c) Describe the mechanism of regulation in the human body (temperature regulation, blood sugar regulation and osmoregulation)
objectives.teaching_methods: Question and answers, Group discussion, ICT based learning
objectives.resources: Charts on temperature and blood sugar regulation and online resouces of temperature regulation, blood sugar regulation and osmoregulation
objectives.assessment_criteria: The mechanism of regulation in the human body is described clearly

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic skills for conducting biological investigations
competences: (a) Investigate the process of nervous coordination (reflex arc and knee jerk)

objectives.text: (a) Investigate the process of nervous coordination (reflex arc and knee jerk)
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, ICT based learning, Experimentation
objectives.resources: Sharp objects, hot objects, animal toys models (snake, scorpion), live small animals specimens and nervous coordination online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The process of nervous coordination is investigated correctly

objectives.resources: Variety of plants Seedlings, pots, seeds, soil, water, boxes and online resources/ charts on tropic responses in plants
objectives.assessment_criteria: Tropic responses in plants are investigated correctly

sub_topics.title: Carry out a biological project work using biological principles
competences: (a) Develop and carry out a simple research project in Biology

objectives.text: (a) Develop and carry out a simple research project in Biology
objectives.resources: Text/online resources on principles of biological projects
objectives.assessment_criteria: A biological research project work is developed and carried out correctly
